--- change 1 (repo omnibase_spi, pull request #206) ---
feat(OMN-10758): port change-aware test selection to omnibase_spi (#206)
Ports the change-aware selective test execution system from omnibase_core
(OMN-9852) to omnibase_spi. When ENABLE_SMART_TESTS=true, CI maps changed
source modules to their reverse-dep test directories instead of running the
full suite on every PR.

- Add scripts/ci/detect_test_paths.py, test_selection_models.py,
  test_selection_loader.py, test_selection_adjacency.yaml
- Adjacency YAML covers all omnibase_spi top-level modules: protocols,
  contracts, enums, factories, effects, registry; protoco

It ports the decision of the check-title bash step in
onex_change_control .github/workflows/pr-title-check-reusable.yml at
babdd13ce68f07df20f989f52ff1c4514d03d896, the step that produces
the required pr-title / check-title c

Adds node_merge_sweep_orchestrator: contract.yaml (node_type orchestrator, operation run_merge_sweep, command topic onex.cmd.omnimarket.merge-sweep-run-requested.v1, terminal events onex.evt.omnimarket.merge-sweep-run-completed.v1 and onex.evt.omnimarket.merge-sweep-run-failed.v1, no event_bus block), metadata.yaml, a package-form entry point and HandlerMergeSweepRun.
